summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Bondi Wave landing page after refactoring from monolithic App.js (~1900 lines) to 18 modular components. All sections render correctly on desktop (1920px) and mobile (375px). All interactive elements work properly.

Desktop Layout - Navigation (sticky with logo + Instagram icon + Shop button)
Desktop Layout - Hero section (Breathe Better heading + product image + Shop Now + Take Quiz buttons)
Desktop Layout - Features (4 cards with auto-cycling highlight)
Desktop Layout - ProductGallery (thumbnail column + main image + bullet points)
Desktop Layout - Benefits (3-column with Sleep/Sport accordions)
Desktop Layout - FAQ (5 items + show more button)
Desktop Layout - Footer (3 columns: Brand, Quick Links, Follow Us)
Mobile Layout (375px) - Navigation (logo + Instagram, no Shop button)
Mobile Layout (375px) - Features (compact: icon left, text right)
Mobile Layout (375px) - ProductGallery (5 thumbnails + mobile key benefits collapsible)
Mobile Layout (375px) - Footer (Quick Links + Follow Us side by side)
Interactive - Assessment quiz modal opens on 'Take The Quiz' click
Interactive - Quiz reaches email gate step
Interactive - Quiz modal close button works
Interactive - FAQ 'Show More' button reveals additional questions
Interactive - ProductGallery thumbnail clicks change main image
Navigation - Sticky nav works on scroll
Animations - Framer Motion fadeUp animations render
Animations - Price counters animate to $29.95 and $1.00
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactoring complete and verified. App.js reduced from ~1900 lines to ~57 lines. All 18 components (AssessmentModal, PromoBanner, Navigation, Hero, Marquee, Features, DeliveryBanner, ProductGallery, StorySection, Benefits, ProductShowcase, SleepRecovery, FAQ, Reviews, EmailSignup, Footer, MobileKeyBenefits, TikTokIcon) plus constants.js and hooks.js are working correctly. Pixel-perfect parity maintained on desktop and mobile.
